anthropic.title: Claude Managed Agents permission policies now include `auto`: the server evaluates each agent or MCP tool call and runs it, denies it, or pauses for your approval.
anthropic.summary: 托管智能体新增自动评估工具调用的权限策略。

anthropic.title: The `ant` CLI adds `ant beta:sessions connect`, which attaches your terminal to a Claude Managed Agents session.
anthropic.summary: ant CLI 新增连接并实时操作托管智能体会话的命令。

anthropic.title: Version 1.30.0 of the `ant` CLI adds `ant apply`, which creates and updates agents, environments, skills, memory stores, and deployments from files in your repository.
anthropic.summary: ant CLI 1.30.0 支持以代码方式管理平台资源。

anthropic.title: Per-message effort changes, in beta, are also available on Google Cloud for Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, and Claude Opus 5, with the same `mid-conversation-output-config-2026-07-01` beta header.
anthropic.summary: Google Cloud 上三款模型支持测试版逐消息调整 effort。

anthropic.title: We've launched Claude Fable 5.1 (`claude-fable-5-1`), the successor to Claude Fable 5 for long-running agentic coding, knowledge work, and research, alongside Claude Mythos 5.1 (`claude-mythos-5-1`) for Project Glasswing participants.
anthropic.summary: 发布 Fable 5.1 与 Mythos 5.1，支持百万上下文和12.8万输出。

anthropic.title: Prompt cache reads on Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 cost $0.25 USD per million tokens: 0.025x the base input price, compared with 0.1x on other models.
anthropic.summary: 两款5.1模型缓存读取降至每百万词元0.25美元。

anthropic.title: On Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, `tool_choice` types `any` and `tool` aren't supported and return a 400 error.
anthropic.summary: 两款5.1模型不支持 tool_choice 的 any 与 tool 类型。

anthropic.title: Thinking blocks produced by Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 are preserved only for the model that produced them or a newer one: earlier models can't read them, and the API drops one replayed to an earlier model.
anthropic.summary: 5.1模型的思考块仅可由原模型或更新模型继续使用。

anthropic.title: Per-message effort changes are in beta on Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1, and Claude Opus 5 on the Claude API.
anthropic.summary: Claude API 三款模型测试逐消息调整 effort。

anthropic.title: Turn-scoped system messages are in beta (`mid-conversation-system-clear-at-2026-08-21` header).
anthropic.summary: 推出仅对当前轮次生效的系统消息测试功能。

anthropic.title: `thinking.display` accepts a third value, `"updates"`, in beta (`thinking-display-updates-2026-08-18` header).
anthropic.summary: thinking.display 新增 updates 测试值以返回进度更新。

anthropic.title: Text generated by Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 carries Anthropic's text watermark, and supported image, video, and audio files that Claude produces through the code execution tool carry C2PA Content Credentials when you retrieve them through the Files API on the Claude API.
anthropic.summary: 两款5.1模型文本带水印，生成媒体可携带C2PA凭证。
